context: CYP51 (sterol 14-alpha-demethylase) Y137F in Zymoseptoria tritici, the wheat septoria pathogen; a documented DMI-azole resistance mechanism.
notes: REFRAMED FROM WHEAT RUST. Y137F is documented in Z. tritici (wheat septoria) and as Y136F in Blumeria graminis - not in Puccinia (wheat rust), which is not primarily controlled by DMI azoles. Reframed to septoria to keep the literature support and the tebuconazole-resistance story intact. Allele caveat: UniProt holds several Z. tritici CYP51 entries (A4ULI5 515 aa, A4ULJ1 517 aa, B2L2K3 364 aa). A4ULI5 is pinned because it is full length and carries Tyr137; B2L2K3 has Lys at 137 and would fail validation. Y137F is usually reported alongside other CYP51 substitutions in field isolates, so treat it as a contributing factor rather than the sole determinant.
source: Cools & Fraaije, CYP51 variant literature in Z. tritici
